vibe: Authority, clarity, and function-first. The interface acts as a transparent translator, converting complex 'nuclear plant' metrics into an intuitive, foolproof 3-step wizard.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Art): One font family. Radical weight contrast (Black vs Light). Very crisp, reliable, and data-heavy vibe but cleanly readable.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8 or p-12 for major containers. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol (Universal): Use MODE B (Control Room) for the 'Professional View' complex dashboard, but for the Wizard, use a focused max-w-4xl centered layout or a split layout (left: stepper progress, right: interactive step content).
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky top header containing Logo on the left, stepper progress in the middle (if applicable), and the 'Profesyonel Görünüm' toggle switch on the right.

components.buttons: Flat colors, no shadow, sharp 1px borders, radical hover states. MUST explicitly define text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. Flat, 1px border-slate-200, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600.
components.cards: Neumorphism is avoided. Use 'Grid Borders' or flat backgrounds with 1px border. No drop shadows; use shadow-sm at most.
components.stepper: Vertical or horizontal step checklist representing the 3 wizard steps.
components.strategy_cards: 12 ready strategies displayed as clean 'Lego' blocks in a grid. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border darkens to primary blue.
components.logical_builder: A custom UI section for 'Kendi Stratejini Yap'. Contains dropdowns/selects for EMA, RSI, MACD, BB, ADX and input sliders/number fields to tweak parameters (e.g., changing RSI from 30 to 25).

wizard_flow.title: Strateji Seç/Kur
wizard_flow.details: Toggle between '12 Hazır Strateji' (Ready-made list) or 'Kendi Stratejini Yap' (Custom Logic Builder: EMA, RSI, MACD, BB, ADX). Users must be able to tweak parameters of the ready-made strategies (e.g., edit RSI 30 to 25).

wizard_flow.title: Bot Ayarla
wizard_flow.details: Attach the selected/built strategy to the bot. Setup API keys, allocation, and limits.

wizard_flow.title: Onayla ve Başlat
wizard_flow.details: Review the summary of the setup and click 'Başlat' to run the bot.

error_translation_map.API_PERMISSION_DENIED: Borsa API izni geçersiz veya eksik
error_translation_map.INVALID_STRATEGY_PARAMS: Strateji kuralları geçersiz, parametreleri kontrol edin

custom_domain_rules.logs_ui: Instead of raw technical logs, show a clean, human-readable status indicator like 'Stratejiye göre alım noktası bekleniyor...'.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text color on hover. Slight lift for clickable strategy cards.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders for strategy fetching. Smooth step transitions in the wizard.

images.description: A clean, modern geometric logo icon for a financial trading bot.
Subtle light grey structural grid on stark white background.
images.usage: Use as a subtle full-page or section background pattern to give a technical but clean vibe (opacity 10-20%).

images.description: Minimalist 3D illustration of clean white and Klein blue lego blocks snapping together.
images.usage: Hero image, empty state illustration, or visual flair in the 'Kendi Stratejini Yap' (Custom Builder) section representing modular strategies.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='strategy-select-card-1', data-testid='wizard-next-step').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA minimums. Warning/Error colors must be checked for legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 3-step wizard as the default primary UI (Strateji Seç/Kur, Bot Ayarla, Onayla ve Başlat).
Include a 'Profesyonel Görünüm' (Professional View) toggle switch in the header that switches between the Wizard and the detailed 'Nuclear Plant' Dashboard.
Implement the strategy selector in Step 1 with two tabs/modes: '12 Hazır Strateji' (Ready) and 'Kendi Stratejini Yap' (Custom).
For the 'Kendi Stratejini Yap' mode, build a Logical Builder using EMA, RSI, MACD, BB, ADX with customizable parameter inputs.
Allow users to select a ready-made strategy and tweak its default parameters (e.g., changing RSI from 30 to 25).
Build a translation map function for error messages ensuring users only see the human-friendly versions (e.g., 'Cüzdan bakiyesi yetersiz') instead of technical codes.
Bot logs should display clean statuses like 'Stratejiye göre alım noktası bekleniyor' instead of raw technical arrays.
Use IBM Plex Sans for all typography with strict hierarchy and weight contrast (font-black vs font-light).
Use standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for the implementation (avoid TypeScript as per environment specs).
Integrate the generated image URLs into the UI.
